name: Sunday Part 2: 4 rounds 10 back squats, 10 alt. barbell lunges, 10 burpee broad jumps
notes: The athlete did the squats and the lunges in one go without racking the bar and turned the Crown twice at the end; the split comes from the motion.

Squat vs lunge from the wrist: horizontal movement relative to vertical is 0.14-0.24 in squats and 0.57-0.73 in lunges (every round), and in lunges 80-83% of it lies on one line (forward-back). Rhythm alone varies between people; this does not.
Squat rep times (rounds 3-4) = descents in the vertical acceleration, 2.6-2.8 s apart. Rounds 1-2 show 9 squats; the athlete believes 10: excluded from training ('training': false).
